metadata.title: GovBench: A Byzantine-Fault-Tolerant Benchmark for AI Governance
metadata.description: GovBench is an open-standard benchmark and dataset for evaluating AI governance resilience: (1) a 33-member Byzantine Fault Tolerant (BFT) safety council with 22/33 supermajority quorum, (2) five adversarial attack classes against safety councils (prompt injection, social-scoring/Article-5 probes, emotion-recognition, biometric categorisation, and encoded harmful requests), (3) a 76-item closed battery (57 harmful / 19 benign) with deterministic, non-LLM scoring, and (4) a SIGIL Ed25519 hash-chained attestation layer so every score is auditably signed. Measured on a RunPod A40 GPU. This record accompanies the arXiv preprint and the open dataset.
